title: Rainmaker Mesa
tagline: Pour rain on a block of rock and watch it become a canyon.
how_to: Drag to pour rain where you want it; use Storm, speed and Water buttons, and New rock to start over.
description: A mesa of layered hard and soft rock sits waiting. Rain droplets carry away sediment and drop it downstream, carving branching valleys, stepped cliffs and pale sandy fans. Concentrate rain in one spot to cut a canyon, or let the storm run fast for thousands of years.
spark: Erosion taken literally: a real droplet-based hydraulic erosion simulation.
proud_of: Alternating hard and soft strata make cliffs and ledges appear as the valleys deepen.
